events.description: A visible muzzle flash and smoke erupt from a firearm held by a figure on the elevated platform, indicating active gunfire toward the foreground figure.

After the initial shot, figures on the platform appear to engage in physical confrontation—some raise arms aggressively, one figure is seen recoiling or being struck amid smoke and motion blur, suggesting close-quarters combat.

events.description: A group of armed individuals on an elevated platform are actively firing weapons; muzzle flashes and smoke are visible, indicating live gunfire.
Continued active shooting from the elevated platform; multiple figures are holding firearms in firing positions with visible smoke and motion blur consistent with discharge.
Close-up frames show individuals with firearms in dynamic motion; bright muzzle-like flashes and heavy smoke suggest ongoing gunfire.
Figures continue to hold and aim firearms; smoke persists and lighting suggests recent or ongoing discharges, though direct muzzle flash is less distinct.
Individuals on platform still in combat-ready stances with weapons raised; smoke and lighting conditions remain consistent with recent shooting activity.
One figure appears to be firing a weapon (hand raised, arm extended); smoke and posture support ongoing shooting, though image clarity is reduced.
A figure in profile holds a firearm in a firing stance; ambient smoke and directional lighting suggest continued engagement, though no explicit muzzle flash is visible in this frame.

A shirtless man stands over a restrained individual seated in a wooden chair-like structure, repeatedly striking or pressing an object (possibly a weapon or tool) against the victim's head/face area while the victim is immobilized and unable to resist.

At least two individuals are holding firearms; muzzle flashes and smoke are visible in frames f0–f3, indicating active discharge of weapons. One figure (in white helmet) appears to fire a rifle, while another (shirtless) holds a pistol-like weapon with visible flash/smoke near barrel.

A shirtless man is seen restraining and physically assaulting another person who is bound or trapped in a wooden structure (resembling a stocks or cage). The victim appears helpless, and the aggressor uses forceful motions consistent with beating or choking.

After the initial assault, two individuals (one shirtless, one wearing dark clothing) engage in mutual physical combat near the wooden structure. Their postures and movements indicate reciprocal striking and grappling, not one-sided abuse.
